x-help.fr: Sur la fiche Google du café : « Demander des avis », puis copier le lien (https://g.page/r/…/review).
x-help.ar: من صفحة المقهى على Google: «طلب مراجعات» ثم انسخ الرابط (https://g.page/r/…/review).

reviewUrl.description: The café's own Google review link, from its Google Business Profile ("Demander des avis" → copy the link, e.g. https://g.page/r/…/review). Without it the module stays off and the validator warns. Never a page of ours or a form in between: the link goes straight to Google.
